title: Heat in Space: Offline Combat
author: PhuntasyProductions
selftext:
Hi, I have vibecoded a small android game where you can build a spaceship and then watch it fight in 1v1 battles. It's fully offline, singleplayer, no ads, no ingame purchases, no loot boxes, no tracking.

Why?

Because I love these kind of games and I'm annoyed by all the pay2win solutions, unfair matchmaking, needing 10 minutes to collect all gems, coins, whatever. I just want to play.

How?

Claude Opus 5.5, single html + javascript wrapped in Capacitor.

Monetize?

Yes, the full version with 100 well balanced opponents will be availabe for 1-2 USD/EUR - Would you recommend ads instead?

It's still in open test phase and I'm looking for feedback to improve it. It's already "good enough" and fun for myself. Any feedback is appreciated! 

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.phuntasyproductions.heatinspace.demo](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.phuntasyproductions.heatinspace.demo)

comments.author: PhuntasyProductions
comments.body: I agree, it's top point on my todo list! Any Ideas?

replies.author: adolphite
replies.body: I don't have any to give you because I also find UI design to be very difficult. Maybe look at games in your genre and see how they made their UI and take screenshots of them, give it to the AI and ask it to make a UI for you by merging at least 2 or more UI designs from the uploads
